content.text: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, tɔn kurɔbu nɔɔbɑ yiru bɑ koo durɔ turo sɔ̃ bu nɛɛ,
sɑ ko bɛsɛn tii diisiɑ kpɑ su tii sebusiɑ.
kpɑ ɑ de sɑ n wunɛn yĩsiru sɔɔwɑ.

content: Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u koo kpiisiɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛɛrɛ kɑ ɡirimɑ Isireli be bɑ tien sɔ̃. Kpɑ tem mɛ, mu dĩɑ ɡeenu mɑ nu n sɑ̃ɑ ben nuku dobu.
Be, be Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ mi, u ben yĩsɑ yoruɑ bɑ n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, bɑ koo bu sokuwɑ tɔn dɛɛrobu.
Yinni Gusunɔ u koo Yerusɑlɛmun tɔn kurɔbu disi wɔkɑ, kpɑ u wuu ɡen tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ, u ɡu siri kɑ win dɑm bɑkɑm tɔn be bɑ rɑɑ ɡon sɔ̃.
Yen biru u koo de dɔ̃ɔ wii bɑkɑru tu Siɔnin ɡuuru kpuro kɑ mɛnnɔ yenu wukiri sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, kpɑ dɔ̃ɔ yɑrɑ yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wɔ̃kuru ɡuu ten wɔllɔ, kpɑ win yiikon ɡirimɑ yu wuu ɡe wukiri,
kpɑ yɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kuru te tɑ ko n bu sɑɑru sɑ̃ɑwɛ yɑm susurun sɑɑ, kɑ mɑɑ kuku yeru woo bɔkɔ kɑ ɡurɑn sɔ̃.
